text:
maya: Quick question — product wants a 'headroom' signal on the rollout dashboard so PMs can see quota/topology risk. Can we show per-slice p50/p95 deltas vs baseline?

sam: Yep. UX idea: a compact row per slice with little percent bar + delta badge and an expand to show sparklines.

lee: We need to decide who computes delta. Computing server-side avoids frontend churn and keeps alerting simple. cardinality concerns if we return too many slice tags though.

jon: Agreed server-side. Backend should return aggregated rows with delta_pct and a reason field for guard evaluation. Then frontend only renders.

sam: Proposed API shape: 
```
GET /api/v1/rollouts/12345/metrics?window=10m&baseline=prod&compare=canary&slice_by=region,model_variant

Response:
{
  "slices": [
    {"slice_key":"region=us-west|variant=gv100q4","metrics":[{"name":"p95","baseline":12.3,"canary":14.5,"delta_pct":18.7}],"guard_reason":"p95_regression"}
  ],
  "summary": {"top_regressions": 3}
}
```

lee: That looks fine. We should enforce a max_slices param and a TTL for cached rollup (eg 30s) to avoid thundering. Also return a cardinality hint for the UI.

maya: Good call on max_slices. Product wants the default to surface the top 10 slices by traffic.

jon: Guard logic proposal: if delta_pct > 10% AND baseline p95 > 50ms then mark "unsafe" and surface in banner. Also attach the exact metric name and numeric delta for audits.

sam: UI needs a lightweight drilldown link that queries backend: /rollouts/:id/metrics/slice?key=<slice_key>&range=30m. Backend should accept pre-aggregated telemetry tags to let SRE slice by route_id/model/quantization.

lee: Watch out for telemetry cardinality. We should require a canonical slice_key (single string) generated by ingest pipeline so backend aggregation is stable. No free-form tags in this endpoint.

maya: Action items: 1) eng-platform add API endpoint that returns aggregated slices + guard_reason (jon/lee) 2) frontend mock for compact rows + expand sparklines (sam) 3) product to confirm top-10 default and threshold knobs (maya).

jon: I'll open a RFC PR with the endpoint contract and example payload. Will include compute sketch for delta and headroom.

sam: I'll mock the compact row and a11y-friendly color thresholds.

lee: I'll draft guard pseudocode and add a warning about cardinality + cache TTL. Also propose a metric: "quota_headroom_pct" = (quota_remaining / expected_qps) * 100.

deploy-bot: Canary r-2026-03-15-1 started on gke-us-west (traffic 5%). :rocket:

maya: Nice. Once RFC is up we can sync tomorrow 10am to finalize fields. :eyes:
